about.html:
Hi, I'm Aminul Islam Saqib, a backend developer passionate about building reliable, scalable, and AI-ready systems. I've worked on projects ranging from CRM platforms and customer support SaaS to EdTech systems and microservice-based applications.

With experience in Node.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, and AWS, I specialize in designing APIs and infrastructures that can support AI/ML workflows — whether it's data aggregation, real-time event processing, or integrating intelligent services.

I'm especially excited about the future of AI-driven automation and how backend systems can power smarter, more adaptive applications.

aboutCards.expertiseText: Backend engineer focused on building scalable architectures, distributed systems, and cloud-native APIs. Passionate about optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and exploring AI integration to create smarter, automation-ready solutions.
aboutCards.experienceText: Software Developer with solid experience across startups and enterprise-scale applications. Over several years in professional development, I’ve led backend architecture, API design, and performance optimization — currently driving SaaS and CRM solutions at Gain Solution Ltd.

projects.title: EasyDesk
projects.description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform that streamlines customer support operations through intelligent ticketing, role-based access, and real-time communication. Designed for scalability and performance, EasyDesk empowers admins, agents, and clients to collaborate efficiently within a unified support ecosystem.
responsibilities: Designed a tenant-aware PostgreSQL schema and optimized queries/indexing to keep complex filters and reports performant at scale.
Implemented secure RBAC and authentication flows for admins, agents, and clients to enforce least-privilege access.
Built real-time ticket updates and collaboration features using GraphQL subscriptions.
Developed an application-level job queue with AWS Lambda and SQS to offload CPU-intensive background tasks, keeping APIs responsive under load.
Expanded critical business logic to support evolving customer requirements and rapid feature delivery.

projects.title: GainIO
projects.description: A Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform designed to streamline client interactions, automate event scheduling, and enhance team collaboration. GainIO provides seamless calendar synchronization, scalable APIs, and efficient workflows to help businesses manage customer relationships effectively.
responsibilities: Architected modular REST/GraphQL APIs in Node.js (Express) to accelerate delivery and keep services maintainable as requirements evolved.
Optimized PostgreSQL with targeted indexing, query refactors, and schema tuning — improving query performance by 40% on reporting and CRM modules.
Designed and deployed event-driven microservices on AWS (Lambda, ECS, SQS, SAM) to support asynchronous workflows and scalable processing.
Integrated Google and Microsoft Calendar APIs with AWS Lambda and SQS to enable reliable, near real-time event synchronization and scheduling automation.
Implemented CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and multi-environment deployments, improving delivery reliability and reducing manual release effort.
Managed Agile sprints via JIRA, ensuring on-time feature delivery and cross-team collaboration.

projects.title: Somoyer School
projects.description: An e-learning platform offering various digital educational solutions, including online courses, workshops, and career development services. The platform provides free and premium courses with video lessons, notes, quizzes, and assignments.
responsibilities: Architected scalable backend infrastructure with comprehensive RESTful APIs for lesson management, authentication, payment processing, and certificate generation serving 10,000+ active users.
Implemented secure MongoDB data layer with role-based access control, middleware guards, and optimized queries achieving 99.5% system reliability.
Led cross-functional collaboration with frontend teams and conducted code reviews in Agile environment, ensuring seamless API integration and maintainable codebase.

projects.title: B2C Online Food Delivery System
projects.description: A comprehensive Business-to-Customer food delivery platform where customers can order from various restaurants, customize orders with add-ons and flavors, apply vouchers for discounts, and track order status in real-time.
responsibilities: Designed microservices architecture from scratch with RabbitMQ messaging system, enabling scalable inter-service communication and 50% faster order processing.
Built comprehensive authentication system with JWT tokens, OTP verification, and refresh token rotation ensuring enterprise-level security standards.
Integrated Aamarpay payment gateway with CORS-enabled APIs, supporting multiple payment methods and real-time transaction tracking.

projects.title: Livestock Payment System
projects.description: A secure payment execution platform for livestock transactions developed for a government entity. Focuses on real-time data tracking and safe payment gateway integration with emphasis on security and compliance.
responsibilities: Developed secure government-compliant payment platform using NestJS and MongoDB, handling livestock transactions worth $2M+ with zero security incidents.
Implemented enterprise-grade authentication with role-based access control and audit trails, meeting strict government security requirements.
Integrated bKash payment gateway with custom APIs and real-time transaction monitoring, achieving 99.8% payment success rate.

projects.title: Meda-X Research Platform
projects.description: A comprehensive data collection and analysis software designed for medical researchers as a resource aggregation application. Enables automated data collection from multiple sources with advanced analytics capabilities.
responsibilities: Built automated data collection system using Node.js web crawlers and Redis caching, processing 1M+ medical research records daily with 95% accuracy rate.
Developed full-stack solution with Spring Boot APIs and PostgreSQL database, optimizing queries to reduce data processing time by 60%.
Created cross-platform Flutter frontend with advanced analytics dashboard, enabling researchers to visualize complex medical data insights in real-time.

experience.description: A global software consultancy and product company rooted in Bangladesh, specialising in custom web & SaaS solutions, leveraging modern stacks for clients worldwide.
highlights: Engineered scalable RESTful and GraphQL APIs serving 100K+ daily requests, supporting both B2B and SaaS platforms.
Architected AWS serverless integrations (Lambda, SQS, SAM) with external service at 95% success.
Integrated Google and Microsoft APIs, including calendar and authentication services, to enable seamless event synchronization and smart scheduling automation across business platforms.
Developed “GainIO” CRM platform — designed modular APIs, improved query performance by 40%, and optimized PostgreSQL schema for advanced analytics and reporting.
Enhanced “EasyDesk” SaaS system by implementing multi-tenant architecture, secure RBAC, and real-time ticketing features using GraphQL subscription
Improved system performance and deployment reliability by optimizing PostgreSQL queries and refining Docker-based CI/CD workflows.

experience.description: A Bangladesh-based software and SaaS development firm focussed on “design-driven development.” They build bespoke applications across industries (food-tech, media, government) with user-centric design and modern technologies.
highlights: Developed scalable backend services for multiple production applications, including a large EdTech and B2C delivery platform, ensuring maintainability and efficient data flow.
Architected microservices using NestJS for authentication, role-based access, and 2FA — improving modularity and scalability.

Architected NestJS-based microservices for authentication, role-based access, and 2FA, integrating RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication to enhance modularity, scalability, and overall system reliability.
Integrated SSLCOMMERZ payment gateway and implemented Redis caching to boost performance, reduce transaction latency, and optimize database query efficiency.
Collaborated closely with frontend teams to ensure seamless API integration and consistent user experience, while supporting team growth through code reviews and promoting Agile best practices.

experience.description: A Germany-based specialist in intelligent automation, AI and software robotics for regulated industries (pharma, medical devices, chemicals). They provide custom automation solutions for complex document- and workflow-intensive processes.
highlights: Built automated data collection systems using Node.js and Python web crawlers, processing millions of medical research records with 95% accuracy for healthcare analytics platform.
Developed full-stack solutions with Spring Boot APIs and Flutter frontend, reducing data processing time by 60% and improving user experience across multiple platforms.
Implemented automated testing frameworks with Selenium and cherio, ensuring 95% code coverage.

experience.description: Taught sessions, supported students, evaluated assessments, and maintained records; assisted with course materials.
highlights: Delivered engaging computer science curriculum to 50+ students across multiple courses, maintaining 95% student satisfaction rating through interactive teaching methods.
Designed and evaluated comprehensive assessments including coding assignments and technical projects, providing detailed feedback to improve student learning outcomes.
Collaborated with faculty to develop course materials and streamline administrative processes, contributing to department efficiency improvements.
